projectDescription: A Memory Operating System for LLMs and AI agents that unifies memory storage, retrieval, and management to enable context-aware, personalized interactions with 35% token savings.
keyFeatures: Unified Memory API for add, search, edit, and delete across text, image, and tool memories
Multi-Cube Knowledge Base Management for isolated, composable memory spaces per user or project
Asynchronous MemScheduler with Redis Streams for production-grade concurrent memory ingestion
Memory Feedback & Correction via natural language to refine and update stored memories
Hybrid retrieval combining vector search and graph traversal for high-accuracy recall
MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration for connecting AI assistants to MemOS
OpenClaw and Hermes Agent plugins with 35–72% token reduction
Self-hosted (Docker/pip) and Cloud API deployment options
35.24% memory token savings and +43.70% accuracy over OpenAI Memory
publicApiSurface: POST /product/add — Add memories from chat messages or documents
POST /product/search — Semantic search across memory cubes
POST /product/get_all — Retrieve all memories for a user
GET /product/get_memory/{memory_id} — Get a memory by ID
MOS.simple() — Python SDK auto-configured MOS instance
MOS.chat(query) — Chat with memory retrieval and storage
GeneralMemCube — Python SDK memory container class
SingleCubeView / CompositeCubeView — View architecture for add/search operations
memos CLI — Command-line interface (entry point: memos)
memos download_examples — CLI command to fetch example code
